notes: Hypothetical Greater Manchester / NW UK land auction lots and specialist plot listings for Auction House, SDL, EG Property Auctions, Plotfinder, and PlotBrowser. Offline smoke only — not live scraped content. Residential house-lot noise included for filter tests.

listings.title: Lot 12 — Building plot with outline PP, Bolton BL1
